newsitem.title: USA: TABLE- Berkshire Q2 net shr $225 vs $159.
newsitem.headline: TABLE- Berkshire Q2 net shr $225 vs $159.

text.p: (All data above in millions except per share numbers)
NOTE: Berkshire Hathaway Inc said net earnings for 1996 are meaningless in evaluating the company's performance.

The 1996 net earnings include a $1.5 billion after-tax realized investment gain, mostly related to Walt Disney's acquisition of Capital Cities/ABC Inc. This compared with $44.2 million after-tax realized investment gain in the first six months of 1997.

While the $1.5 billion gain had a material impact on the company's reported 1996 earnings, it hardly affected shareholders equity, because most of the appreciatinon of Capital Cities stock was already reflected in shareholders equity before the 1996 first quarter.

Berkshire attributed the rise in operating income for the first half of 1997 to its GEICO unit's underwriting results; a $55 million after-tax dividend income from its holding U.S. Airways cumulative convertible preferred stock; and the results of its unit FlightSafety, which it bought at the end of 1996.
